players.product: HYFT biological representation, ReefIQ data layer and LensAI platform for AI drug discovery

quarterly_data.signal: Liquidity (Q1 FY2027 MD&A and interim statements): cash on hand and restricted cash was C$7.8 million at July 31, 2026 vs C$11.5 million at April 30, 2026, and the accumulated deficit reached C$148.8 million. The company expects its cash on hand will be insufficient to fund operations for at least one year from the date the statements are issued, which raises substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern unless it obtains financing; the timing and scope of advancing its four AI/HYFT-driven internal programs will depend on available financing. A material weakness in internal control over financial reporting (insufficient resources for complex technical accounting) remained unremediated at July 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: cash and restricted cash C$7.8 million; accumulated deficit C$148.8 million; substantial doubt about going concern

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 revenue mix (interim statements): MindWalk has one reportable segment, antibody discovery and related services. Project revenue was C$3,831 thousand (+22.6%) vs C$3,126 thousand and cryostorage revenue C$2 thousand vs C$33 thousand. By geography: United States C$2,554 thousand (C$2,449 thousand), Europe C$174 thousand (C$520 thousand), Canada C$120 thousand (C$174 thousand) and Other C$986 thousand (nil a year earlier). Deferred revenue was C$529 thousand at July 31, 2026 vs C$1,073 thousand at April 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: project revenue C$3,831 thousand (+22.6%); United States C$2,554 thousand; Other C$986 thousand; deferred revenue C$529 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline (MD&A): four AI/HYFT-driven internal programs - a GLP-1 receptor agonist (AI-designed peptide; preclinical, in vitro receptor activation confirmed by an independent third-party assay against a semaglutide benchmark), a longevity companion therapeutic (undisclosed target; identified in silico, validation underway; a potential co-administration candidate with the GLP-1 agonist), a universal dengue vaccine (conserved epitope across all 4 serotypes; rabbit immunization completed, third-party neutralization testing underway) and universal influenza (functional constraint confirmed across >900 influenza A and B sequence variations). Each program is designed to be housed and financed independently. Separately, 'the Vault' holds 16 partner-ready antibody and biologics assets across oncology, immuno-oncology, vascular disease, ophthalmology and infectious disease, several already partnered - including CD3 Fabs (MDWK-24), ALK-1 agonist antibodies (MDWK-21), a TrkB x CD3 bispecific (MDWK-200) and SARS-CoV-2 (MDWK-03, in final drug product form); subsidiary Talem Therapeutics in Massachusetts runs partnered therapeutic discovery.
quarterly_data.figure: 4 internal AI-driven programs; 16 partner-ready Vault assets
